articles.title: Oracle beats Microsoft and Amazon on a key Wall Street metric
articles.summary: Oracle received the strongest valuation grade among seven major technology companies following Thursday's sector selloff.
articles.body: Oracle Corp. ( ORCL , Financials ) was best stock on a valuation basis out of seven big technology and cloud computing firms as investors remained cautious after a steep selloff in artificial intelligence equities.Oracle scored a B rating and IBM and Amazon received a D rating. Apple, Meta Platforms, Alphabet and Microsoft all got F scores.The rating assesses stock prices compared to firm fundamentals, with higher grades indicating more favorable valuations according to the methodology.Oracle shares were up 2.5% in premarket trade Friday as AI and semiconductor sectors tried to rebound from losses on Thursday.Other big technology stocks were divided. Meta and Alphabet climbed 0.4% apiece as Amazon slipped 1% and Microsoft slid 1.5%.The value discrepancy reflects how investors are valuing key cloud and technology businesses despite uncertainties about investing on AI infrastructure.But a better relative valuation rating doesn't always suggest Oracle has less risk.The corporation still has big data-center investment needs and doubts about how much return such projects will deliver.The next trigger will be if the IT sector bounce continues and investors re-rate Oracle on its capital investment and earnings projections.

articles.title: Michael Burry Takes Profits on Major AI Bear Bet
articles.summary: Burry sold 25% of his SMH puts but says the remaining position is still very large.
articles.body:
The famed investor disclosed that he sold 25% of his put options on the VanEck Semiconductor ETF ( NASDAQ:SMH ) after a sharp selloff across U.S. chip and technology stocks.

But that does not mean Burry has turned bullish.

He said the remaining SMH put position has become very large, suggesting the trade still represents a major part of his bearish exposure.

That distinction matters because SMH owns many of the biggest beneficiaries of the AI boom, including Nvidia ( NASDAQ:NVDA ), Taiwan Semiconductor ( NYSE:TSM ), AMD ( NASDAQ:AMD ), Broadcom and Micron ( NASDAQ:MU ) .

SMH plunged about 11.2% on November 5 , while the Nasdaq Composite fell 5.5% and the QQQ ETF dropped 6.5%, giving bearish positions a significant opportunity to lock in gains.

Burry had previously concentrated much of his bearish exposure into puts on SMH and the Nasdaq-100 with expirations in 2027, while arguing that the AI trade could be approaching a major market top.

He is also still holding puts on Palantir ( NASDAQ:PLTR ), Oracle ( NYSE:ORCL ), Caterpillar and QQQ , according to his latest disclosure.

At the same time, Burry is not broadly bearish on every stock.

He disclosed that he added to his position in MercadoLibre , buying shares below $1,500 after the company reported earnings.

I think the key point is that Burry is trimming risk, not reversing his thesis .

Selling 25% of the SMH puts after an 11% one-day plunge is classic profit-taking.

The more important signal is that he still describes the remaining position as very large and continues to hold several other bearish technology bets.

That means investors should not read this as Burry calling a bottom in semiconductors.

Instead, it suggests he believes the selloff has already moved far enough to justify locking in some gains while still expecting further downside.

For investors, the key things to watch are whether Burry trims more of the position, Nvidia's next earnings report, semiconductor valuations, AI capex expectations, and whether the broader Nasdaq correction deepens from here .

articles.body:
Markets are trembling amid the latest AI stock sell-off, which has sent shares of major AI players deep into the red. But CNBC's Jim Cramer believes the downturn is not another dot-com crash.

Cramer warned that AI stocks could fall further, particularly semiconductor companies whose shares surged during the AI boom. However, he argued that unlike the speculative businesses that collapsed in 2000, many of today's AI companies are highly profitable.

His biggest concern is smaller AI infrastructure companies such as CoreWeave, Iren and Nebius, which have borrowed heavily to finance data center projects that could face regulatory delays.

Before the election too, Cramer was more careful about tech. On Mad Money, he said the Nasdaq had just closed its worst month since March 2025 and that the week ahead "might be even worse." He said he wanted to see a "crescendo" before putting more money into tech, which he described as stocks getting crushed in the morning and then rallying on big volume to finish higher. He also warned that anti-data center politicians could stop projects if Democrats took control, and data center stocks fell on Wednesday on fears of tighter AI regulation, Reuters reported.

articles.title: Imposto do pecado: Álcool e tabaco são taxados em 38 países ricos | G1
articles.standfirst: Criado pela reforma tributária, imposto seletivo tem como objetivo encarecer produtos ou atividades que causam danos à saúde ou ao meio ambiente nos próximos anos.
articles.summary: Com início em fevereiro, o imposto do pecado taxará bebidas e cigarros para cobrir gastos bilionários do SUS, seguindo uma tendência adotada por 38 países ricos.
articles.body:
O anúncio de que o imposto seletivo – conhecido como "imposto do pecado" – passará a ser cobrado a partir de fevereiro do ano que vem gerou forte repercussão no setor produtivo e nas redes sociais.

🔎 Criado pela reforma tributária sobre o consumo, o "imposto do pecado" começará a ser cobrado em fevereiro e tem o objetivo de encarecer produtos ou atividades que causam danos à saúde ou ao meio ambiente nos próximos anos.

No próximo ano, o governo diz que o objetivo é manter a atual carga tributária de cada produto, ou seja, sem aumento de imposto. Mas alguns setores afetados têm se queixado de que a tributação será maior.

🔎 No Brasil, a lista inclui bebidas alcoólicas, refrigerantes e cigarros. O novo imposto também incidirá sobre alguns veículos, conforme o nível de poluição, sobre a extração de bens minerais e sobre loterias.

Apesar das queixas de alguns setores, o imposto do pecado (conhecido como "sin tax" ou "excise tax" em inglês) não é um exemplo de uma "jabuticaba" brasileira, ou seja, algo que existe apenas no Brasil.

➡️Segundo estudo de 2024 sobre tributação do consumo da Organização para a Cooperação e Desenvolvimento Econômico ( OCDE ), fórum que reúne 38 países, todas as nações do grupo mantêm impostos seletivos ("excise duties") sobre tabaco e bebidas alcoólicas.

'Imposto do pecado': governo federal define as alíquotas do tributo, que começa a ser cobrado em 2027 — Foto: Jornal Nacional/ Reprodução

O relatório da OCDE também inclui os combustíveis entre os produtos comumente sujeitos a impostos seletivos. O levantamento, porém, não traz uma relação consolidada dos países que adotam esse tipo de tributação sobre combustíveis.

O estudo não inclui bebidas açucaradas entre as principais categorias analisadas. Relatório de 2025 da Organização Mundial da Saúde (OMS), porém, aponta que alguns países adotam tributos específicos sobre esses produtos, entre eles Reino Unido, México, Portugal e França.

O documento da OCDE avalia que os impostos seletivos são amplamente usados para influenciar o comportamento dos consumidores e desestimular o consumo de produtos associados a impactos negativos sobre a saúde ou o meio ambiente — objetivo do imposto do pecado brasileiro.

Veja quanto será cobrado no imposto do pecado no Brasil

vinhos, espumantes, proseccos e champanhe (excetuados os vinhos da madeira, do porto e de xerez) : 8%;

vinhos da madeira, do porto e de xerez: 16%;

bebidas alcoólicas prontas para consumo, como drinks enlatados, com teor acima de 8%: 16%;

uísque, vodca, gim e tequila entre outros: 24%;

cigarros: alíquota de 66,7%, mais R$ 3,50.

O texto estabelece, por exemplo, critérios de sustentabilidade e eficiência energética para a definição das alíquotas incidentes sobre veículos, aeronaves e embarcações.

Determinadas categorias de veículos terão alíquota zero, incluindo aqueles adquiridos por pessoas com deficiência ou com transtorno do espectro autista e por motoristas profissionais que utilizem o automóvel na categoria de aluguel (táxi), observadas as condições previstas na medida.

Veja alguns dos principais produtos afetados

➡️ Um levantamento da Fiocruz, citado pelo Ministério da Saúde, aponta que o consumo de álcool gerou custos de R$ 18,8 bilhões em 2019 . Desse total, R$ 1,1 bilhão correspondeu a gastos federais diretos com internações e atendimentos ambulatoriais no Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS). Outros R$ 17,7 bilhões foram associados à perda de produtividade causada por mortes prematuras, afastamentos do trabalho, aposentadorias precoces e licenças médicas relacionadas a doenças provocadas pelo consumo de álcool.

➡️ No Brasil, segundo o Ministério da Saúde, as doenças relacionadas ao tabagismo geram custos indiretos de R$ 86,3 bilhões por ano. Considerando também os custos diretos, o impacto econômico anual chega a R$ 153,5 bilhões, o equivalente a 1,6% do PIB. "Em contrapartida, a arrecadação de tributos federais na venda de cigarros é de apenas R$ 8 bilhões por ano, o que evidencia desequilíbrio entre os gastos com a saúde e a arrecadação gerada pela comercialização do produto", diz.

➡️ Em um estudo para embasar a cobrança do Imposto Seletivo, o governo estimou que o tratamento de doenças associadas ao consumo de bebidas ultraprocessadas, como refrigerantes, isotônicos e refrescos, custa quase R$ 3 bilhões por ano ao Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS).

➡️ Produtores nacionais afirmam que as bebidas alcoólicas já são muito tributadas no Brasil, com impostos que representam de 40% a mais de 80% do preço dos produtos . Segundo o setor, um eventual aumento da tributação pode reduzir as margens de lucro, elevar os preços ao consumidor, provocar demissões e estimular o mercado ilegal.

articles.title: Investidores perdem confiança no setor de IA e colocam IPO da Anthropic em risco | G1
articles.standfirst: Investidores consideram elevada a avaliação de R$ 8,22 trilhões discutida para a empresa e cobram condições mais atraentes, em meio à onda de vendas de ações de tecnologia e à incerteza sobre o setor de IA.
articles.summary: Investidores consideram elevada a avaliação de R$ 8,22 trilhões discutida para a empresa e cobram condições mais atraentes, em meio à onda de vendas de ações de tecnologia e à incerteza sobre o setor de IA.
articles.body:
Logo da Anthropic em ilustração feita em junho de 2026. — Foto: Dado Ruvic/Reuters

Potenciais investidores na oferta pública inicial de ações (IPO, na sigla em inglês) da Anthropic têm dúvidas se a startup de inteligência artificial conseguirá realizar na próxima semana a rodada de apresentações a investidores e abrir o capital ainda em novembro, segundo fontes a par das discussões.

Os investidores pressionam por um valor de mercado mais atraente para participar da oferta. Alguns consideram que a avaliação de US$ 1,5 trilhão (R$ 8,22 trilhões) , discutida recentemente, está no limite superior das expectativas, disseram as fontes à Reuters.

As discussões refletem, em parte, a maior onda de vendas de ações de tecnologia em um ano e as incertezas geopolíticas , que afetam as perspectivas para novas ofertas de ações.

A Anthropic não comentou as dúvidas dos investidores.

Inicialmente, a expectativa era que a rodada de apresentações aos investidores começasse na semana de 9 de novembro, conforme noticiado anteriormente pela Reuters. A definição do preço das ações estava prevista para a semana seguinte.

A Anthropic pode precisar reduzir o valor pedido pelas ações para atrair investidores. Segundo as fontes, pesa nessa negociação a necessidade da empresa de levantar recursos, diante do histórico de prejuízos trimestrais e dos compromissos financeiros assumidos com parceiros para expandir suas operações de IA.

Os investidores também aguardam os dados de receita da Anthropic referentes a outubro, que não foram informados no formulário S-1 atualizado, documento apresentado no processo de abertura de capital. Os números devem ajudar a avaliar se a empresa conseguiu acelerar o crescimento após uma desaceleração nos últimos meses, disseram duas das fontes.

Em Wall Street e no Vale do Silício, aumentaram na quinta-feira as dúvidas sobre a continuidade da oferta, após dois dias de forte queda dos ativos ligados à IA. O movimento ocorreu depois das eleições de meio de mandato nos EUA, realizadas na terça-feira (3).

Um eventual adiamento da oferta poderia ampliar as preocupações com o setor de IA. O cenário coincide com a aprovação, em vários estados, de iniciativas eleitorais para limitar a expansão de centros de dados, o que reforçou a oposição política a essas instalações e a outros aspectos relacionados à inteligência artificial.

Um adiamento da Anthropic também poderia afetar o mercado de ações, fortemente influenciado pelas grandes empresas de tecnologia. A percepção de que a companhia enfrenta dificuldades para levantar recursos poderia pressionar o valor de mercado dessas empresas.

Em determinado momento deste ano, investidores esperavam que a abertura de capital ocorresse em outubro e avaliasse a Anthropic em até US$ 2 trilhões (R$ 10,96 trilhões) .

Muitos investidores continuam apostando na expansão da IA, embora as vendas de ativos ligados ao setor tenham pressionado o mercado no último mês. Alguns analistas afirmam que a Anthropic, assim como a SpaceX, provavelmente será beneficiada pela demanda de pequenos investidores.

"Não é como se essas empresas não fossem fazer parte do futuro", disse Rick Meckler, sócio da Cherry Lane Investments, uma gestora de investimentos familiar em New Vernon, Nova Jersey.

"Elas vão abrir o capital. Os investidores ainda terão muito interesse nelas. As avaliações vêm subindo há muito tempo no mercado privado, e provavelmente veremos alguma retração."

Mesmo que a Anthropic e os investidores cheguem a um acordo sobre o valor de mercado da empresa, como Wall Street espera, outros fatores podem determinar se a abertura de capital ocorrerá até o fim do ano.

Se os ativos ligados à IA continuarem sob pressão, a empresa poderá adiar a oferta até que as condições do mercado melhorem e haja maior capacidade para absorver uma operação que, segundo algumas estimativas, pode chegar a US$ 100 bilhões (R$ 548 bilhões) , disseram fontes a par das discussões com investidores.

O "The Wall Street Journal" noticiou na noite de quinta-feira que investidores estão céticos quanto à possibilidade de a Anthropic atingir um valor de mercado de US$ 1,5 trilhão (R$ 8,22 trilhões) na abertura de capital.

Os mercados tiveram um dia de instabilidade na quinta-feira, em meio aos resultados das eleições desta semana, a acontecimentos envolvendo empresas e ao aumento das preocupações dos investidores.

A Microsoft reforçou a supervisão de projetos de centros de dados de empresas que oferecem infraestrutura de computação em nuvem, como Nebius, IREN e Nscale, informou a Bloomberg News na quinta-feira, citando pessoas a par do assunto.

Nebius, IREN e CoreWeave estiveram entre as empresas que mais caíram no dia. Cada uma perdeu metade de seu valor de mercado no último mês.

Ao mesmo tempo, investidores venderam ativos ligados à IA.

Os contratos usados para proteção contra o risco de calote, conhecidos pela sigla CDS, atingiram níveis recordes para CoreWeave e SpaceX, indicando aumento da preocupação com a capacidade dessas empresas de cumprir suas obrigações financeiras nos próximos anos.

Mais de 50 ações de empresas de tecnologia que integram o S&P 1500 caíram 10% ou mais. Segundo a Vanda Research, as vendas feitas por pequenos investidores foram as mais intensas desde o início da pandemia da Covid-19.

"Estamos vendo agora uma espécie de greve dos compradores no setor de tecnologia", disse Keith Lerner, diretor de investimentos da Truist Advisory Services, em Atlanta.

No último mês, o setor de tecnologia teve desempenho 10,7% inferior ao do S&P 500, a maior diferença negativa desde maio de 2002, segundo Lerner.

Ele descreveu as vendas até o momento como incômodas, mas não anormais, e acrescentou que "o elástico está ficando esticado".

articles.title: BC paraguaio diz que devolveu dinheiro de 1,2 milhão de correntistas do banco Ueno | G1
articles.standfirst: Em coletiva neste sábado, autoridades detalharam o pagamento de cerca de R$ 880 milhões. Aposentados também foram assegurados de que receberão no dia 17 de novembro.
articles.summary: Em coletiva neste sábado, autoridades detalharam o pagamento de cerca de R$ 880 milhões. Aposentados também foram assegurados de que receberão no dia 17 de novembro.
articles.body:
O Banco Central do Paraguai (BCP) declarou neste sábado (7) que 1.196.000 correntistas do Banco Ueno tiveram seu dinheiro devolvido . Os fundos haviam sido bloqueados após o fechamento repentino do banco.

O balanço foi apresentado durante uma coletiva de imprensa no Palácio López, após uma reunião de emergência entre o presidente interino Pedro Alliana, ministros da Economia e Finanças e a diretoria do BCP. No total, foi devolvido o equivalente a cerca de R$ 880 milhões.

O ministro da Economia e Finanças, Óscar Lovera, afirmou que o governo mobilizou todas as frentes para dar uma resposta rápida à crise. "Fomos instruídos a fazer o máximo esforço para tranquilizar os poupadores afetados", declarou.

O dinheiro saiu do Fundo de Garantia de Depósitos, uma reserva estratégica mantida pelo Banco Central justamente para resguardar os poupadores em cenários de quebra ou intervenção bancária.

O presidente interino do BCP, Pedro Acosta, ressaltou que o BCP segue analisando alternativas para auxiliar os depositantes cujos saldos ultrapassavam o limite coberto pela garantia.

A coletiva também detalhou o impacto da medida sobre os beneficiários do Instituto de Seguridade Social (IPS), principal organismo de previdência e seguridade social no Paraguai. Segundo o presidente do órgão, Derlis León, o próximo pagamento mensal dos pensionistas será depositado normalmente no dia 17 de novembro.

Cerca de 32.000 aposentados (de um total de 90.000) recebiam seus benefícios por meio do Banco Ueno. León garantiu que os trâmites finais para transferir essas contas para outros oito bancos locais estão sendo concluídos para evitar prejuízos aos beneficiários.

Entenda a crise financeira do Paraguai que levou ao impeachment

O Ueno Bank , maior banco digital do Paraguai e principal emissor de cartões de crédito do país, enfrenta problemas financeiros e é alvo de investigações.

A instituição tem cerca de 3 milhões de clientes e passou por uma intervenção do Banco Central paraguaio, que interrompeu o acesso dos correntistas ao dinheiro depositado.

A situação se agravou depois que ajustes nos balanços do banco fizeram seu índice de solvência — indicador que mede a capacidade de uma instituição financeira de cumprir suas obrigações — cair para menos da metade do mínimo exigido pela regulamentação.

Diante do risco, o Banco Central iniciou um procedimento para proteger os depositantes e evitar que os problemas atingissem outras instituições financeiras.

O Ministério Público também pediu a abertura de uma investigação criminal e determinou a prisão de oito pessoas ligadas ao banco. Ao todo, 27 pessoas são investigadas por suspeita de fraude e estelionato.

Nos meses anteriores à crise, o Ueno já estava sob maior fiscalização.

Os órgãos reguladores investigavam se a instituição havia financiado indiretamente a venda de uma carteira de ativos de uma empresa ligada ao Grupo Vázquez, seu controlador. O banco negava ter participado da operação.

O caso também ganhou dimensão política .

Carlos Carvallo , que presidia o Banco Central e havia comandado o próprio Ueno até agosto de 2023, renunciou ao cargo na terça-feira (3), em meio às críticas sobre a fiscalização da instituição .

O então presidente do país, Santiago Peña, sofreu impeachment e foi destituído da presidência na tarde de sexta-feira (6), e logo depois teve sua prisão decretada por envolvimento no escândalo do banco.

A crise provocou protestos de clientes que foram às agências e encontraram as portas fechadas. Entre os afetados estão aposentados que recebem benefícios do governo por meio do banco.

O Ueno administra aproximadamente US$ 850 milhões em recursos públicos , incluindo valores do Instituto de Previsão Social (IPS), responsável pelo pagamento de aposentadorias e pensões no país.

Nos dias anteriores à sua queda, quando ainda tentava conter a crise, Peña havia anunciado um acordo com o Congresso para acelerar a votação do uso do Fundo de Garantia de Depósitos, Peña anunciou um acordo com lideranças do Congresso para acelerar a votação de um projeto que autorizasse o uso do Fundo de Garantia de Depósitos para ressarcir os clientes.

O mecanismo funciona como uma proteção para quem mantém dinheiro em instituições financeiras: em determinadas situações, o fundo é utilizado para devolver os valores depositados, respeitando os limites previstos em lei.

O ex-presidente também afirmou que a medida deveria assegurar a devolução de recursos públicos mantidos pelo IPS e por outros fundos de previdência.

Apesar da gravidade do caso, o Banco Central e o governo mantêm a avaliação de que a quebra do Ueno foi um problema isolado e não representa um risco sistêmico para a economia paraguaia.

articles.title: Cidade das galinhas: conheça o município que tem 370 aves por pessoa | G1
articles.standfirst: Santa Maria de Jetibá, no Espírito Santo, tem nada menos que 15,1 milhões de galinhas poedeiras. Atividade responde por até metade da renda do local e envolve cerca de 20 mil trabalhadores.
articles.summary: Santa Maria de Jetibá, no Espírito Santo, tem nada menos que 15,1 milhões de galinhas poedeiras. Atividade responde por até metade da renda do município.
articles.body:
Em Santa Maria de Jetibá no Espirito Santo a Avicultura movimenta a economia local. — Foto: Divulgação

Santa Maria de Jetibá, no Espírito Santo, é o município que mais produz ovos no Brasil.

Com cerca de 41 mil moradores, a cidade tem aproximadamente 370 galinhas poedeiras — aves criadas para produzir ovos — para cada habitante , segundo dados do Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE).

Ao todo, são 15,1 milhões de galinhas , responsáveis pela produção de 352,5 milhões de dúzias de ovos por ano, o equivalente a cerca de 11,6 milhões de ovos por dia.

Santa Maria de Jetibá no Espirito Santo lidera a produção de ovos no Brasil — Foto: g1

O secretário municipal de Agropecuária, Vanderlei Marquez, afirmou ao g1 que a avicultura responde por cerca de 40% a 50% da renda da cidade. Segundo ele, aproximadamente 20 mil dos 40 mil moradores da cidade trabalham direta ou indiretamente no setor.

A produção de ovos movimenta atividades que vão além das granjas. O setor emprega trabalhadores em entrepostos, transportadoras, fábricas de ração e de embalagens, além dos profissionais responsáveis pelos cuidados com as aves.

Mas a atividade rural de Santa Maria de Jetibá não se resume aos ovos de galinha. O município também se destaca pelo cultivo de chuchu, de morango e pela produção de ovos de codorna.

Santa Maria de Jetibá no Espirito Santo é o principal polo da avicultura nacional — Foto: g1

Por que tantas galinhas produzem ovos, e não carne?

Segundo Marquez, os produtores optaram por se especializar na produção de ovos, em vez de criar frangos para abate, por considerarem a atividade mais rentável.

Com milhões de galinhas poedeiras, o município desenvolveu toda uma cadeia produtiva que vai da criação das aves à coleta, classificação e distribuição dos ovos.

Granja de galinhas poedeiras em Santa Maria de Jetibá — Foto: g1

Manter milhões de galinhas produzindo ovos exige estrutura e investimento. Em Santa Maria de Jetibá, a dificuldade de encontrar mão de obra também levou os produtores a apostar na automação das granjas.

Nelas, as esteiras transportam os ovos dos ninhos até os entrepostos, enquanto outros sistemas controlam a distribuição de ração e água para as aves.

"A construção de uma granja moderna, com capacidade para cerca de 100 mil aves, custa de R$ 3 milhões a R$ 4 milhões", explicou Marquez.

Além dos gastos com a estrutura, os produtores precisam lidar com os custos de operação e com as exigências sanitárias.

Santa Maria de Jetibá já teve um número ainda maior de galinhas. O município chegou a ter quase 22 milhões de aves, mas o plantel caiu para algo entre 16 milhões e 17 milhões durante a crise enfrentada pelo setor em 2013.

Na época, os produtores enfrentavam custos elevados e dificuldades para adequar as granjas às exigências sanitárias. Segundo o secretário, as autuações e os custos para cumprir essas regras contribuíram para que parte dos pequenos avicultores abandonasse a atividade.

articles.title: Reforma tributária: compare as alíquotas de Lula e Bolsonaro | G1
articles.standfirst: Embora não tenha enviado projeto próprio, equipe econômica de Lula participou ativamente das negociações com Congresso e ajudou a construir modelo em vigor. Guedes defendia CBS em patamar mais elevado do que o de 11,3% estimado pelo TCU.
articles.summary: A reforma tributária traz alíquota da CBS estimada em 11,3%, patamar próximo aos 12% propostos por Paulo Guedes, e mantém o chamado imposto do pecado.
articles.body:
A divulgação da estimativa de alíquota da Contribuição Sobre Bens e Serviços (CBS) – o futuro imposto sobre consumo do governo federal no âmbito da reforma tributária – gerou uma onda de críticas de representantes do setor produtivo.

O receio é de que o tamanho da alíquota, estimada em 11,3% pelo Tribunal de Contas da União para 2027 , represente aumento da carga tributária, principalmente no setor de serviços — menos beneficiado com o aproveitamento de créditos tributários de cadeias anteriores.

▶️Somado ao imposto dos estados e municípios, com cobrança integral prevista para 2033, a previsão de analistas é que o futuro imposto sobre o consumo atinja 30%. Se confirmada, seria maior do que a alíquota de todos os países desenvolvidos.

A proposta do TCU será encaminhada ao Congresso Nacional , que poderá concordar ou não. Caberá ao Senado fixar, até 15 de dezembro, o valor final da alíquota a ser cobrada a partir de 2027 .

À época, a proposta não englobou um imposto sobre o consumo de estados e municípios para que não fosse preciso mexer na Constituição Federal.

Bastaria aprovar projeto de lei sobre o assunto, que depende de menor adesão de deputados e senadores. A reforma do ICMS e ISS estadual e municipal ficaria para um segundo momento.

Já a reforma tributária aprovada pelo Congresso no governo Lula teve como principais referências a PEC 45, elaborada a partir dos estudos de Bernard Appy, então no Centro de Cidadania Fiscal (CCiF), e o substitutivo apresentado pelo deputado Aguinaldo Ribeiro em 2023.

➡️O governo Lula não encaminhou uma proposta própria de reforma do consumo ao Congresso, mas participou ativamente das negociações por meio da equipe do Ministério da Fazenda e defendeu diversos pontos incorporados ao texto final.

Uma das diferenças entre os textos é que a proposta de reforma tributária sobre o consumo de Guedes, defensor da autonomia dos entes federativos, contemplava apenas um imposto federal, deixando de fora os tributos dos estados e municípios.

A reforma aprovada no governo Lula baseou-se no modelo de Bernard Appy (CCiF), mas adaptou o projeto original: em vez de um imposto único (IBS) gerido por todos, o Congresso optou pelo IVA Dual, dividindo-o em CBS (federal) e IBS (estadual/municipal) para preservar a autonomia dos entes federativos.

Ambas as propostas (Lula e Guedes) compartilhavam o conceito de IVA e a instituição de um imposto seletivo, também chamado de 'imposto do pecado' . O projeto original de Appy, entretanto, previa a substituição de cinco tributos (PIS, Cofins, IPI, ICMS e ISS) por um único imposto, o IBS.

As duas propostas tinham em comum a substituição de PIS e Cofins por um tributo nos moldes de um imposto sobre valor agregado (IVA), além da intenção de instituir um imposto seletivo sobre produtos considerados prejudiciais à saúde ou ao meio ambiente.

Pressionados pelo setor produtivo da economia, os chefes das equipes econômicas também informaram que buscariam reduzir a alíquota no futuro .

“Não estabilizamos ainda a alíquota. Fizemos uma primeira proposta. Se isso se revelar exagerado, a gente baixa”, afirmou Guedes naquele momento.

Nesta semana, o ministro da Fazenda, Dario Durigan, afirmou que o governo buscará discutir com o Congresso, no decorrer do ano de 2027, uma revisão dos benefícios fiscais previstos na reforma tributária sobre o consumo .

O objetivo, segundo ele, é reduzir alguns incentivos aprovados a produtos e setores da sociedade para baixar, no futuro, a alíquota da Contribuição Sobre Bens e Serviços (CBS) do governo federal.

🔎Entenda: a reforma tributária prevê manter estável a carga tributária sobre o consumo. Assim, como o Congresso aprovou um amplo conjunto de benefícios para produtos e setores com desoneração ou alíquota reduzida, a alíquota necessária para os demais segmentos da economia ficou mais alta.

"É um primeiro número que mantém a carga tributária conforme aprovado pelo Congresso e vai nos dar as condições, de novo, de fazer um debate claro, já mais baixo do que o governo anterior propôs. Para que a gente siga revendo as exceções, os regimes favorecidos, de modo que a gente tenha uma alíquota menor com tempo", disse o ministro a jornalistas.

As duas propostas contemplavam a manutenção do patamar vigente da carga tributária sobre o consumo , algo que penaliza a população mais pobre por conta do alto grau de "regressividade", ou seja, arrecada-se proporcionalmente mais de quem ganha menos.

Números da Receita mostram que impostos sobre bens e serviços, ou seja, os tributos indiretos embutidos nos preços, são muito maiores do que nos países desenvolvidos, enquanto a tributação sobre a renda e o patrimônio (que incidem sobre os mais ricos) tem peso menor no Brasil.

Ambas as propostas também traziam o modelo não cumulativo , de imposto sobre valor agregado , vigente no resto do mundo. Isso significa que, ao longo da cadeia de produção, o imposto é cobrado em cada etapa, mas os contribuintes podem descontar o tributo pago anteriormente.

Os dois projetos também prometiam simplificar o sistema tributário , diminuir custo das empresas , conferir maior transparência , combater a sonegação fiscal, desonerar as exportações e gerar mais investimentos na economia .

A reforma aprovada no governo Lula prevê que o IVA seja cobrado no destino , onde os bens e serviços são consumidos, e não mais na origem . A transição será gradual e levará décadas.

Como a proposta do governo Bolsonaro se restringia aos tributos federais, sem incluir impostos estaduais e municipais , ela não tratava dessa mudança.

As duas reformas também previam tratamento diferenciado para setores da sociedade, ou produtos específicos. Veja abaixo:

✅ Simples Nacional : manutenção do benefício foi proposta no governo Bolsonaro, e também foi previsto na reforma tributária aprovada na gestão do presidente Lula. As empresas poderão optar se permanecem no regime, ou se optam pelo novo modelo (híbrido) que permite abater créditos tributários. O prazo vai até 20 de dezembro.

✅ Zona Franca de Manaus : governo Bolsonaro propôs que os incentivos fiscais fossem mantidos, com a criação mecanismos específicos para preservar as vantagens competitivas. Zona Franca continuou com benefícios na reforma aprovada no atual governo.

✅ Regime monofásico de combustíveis : foi proposto por Paulo Guedes e mantido na atual reforma. A cobrança continua concentrada em etapas específicas da cadeia, justamente por razões operacionais e de controle tributário.

✅ Regime agrícola : a proposta de Guedes previa a manutenção do regime agrícola para assegurar condições equivalentes de concorrência aos pequenos produtores rurais. A reforma aprovada também manteve tratamento diferenciado para o setor agropecuário e para cooperativas.

✅ Instituições financeiras : A proposta de Guedes previa uma CBS própria de 5,8% para bancos, seguradoras e planos de saúde. Na reforma aprovada, o setor financeiro também recebeu tratamento tributário específico, embora diferente do modelo proposto pelo governo Bolsonaro.

✅ Transporte coletivo : proposta de Guedes previa regime favorecido. No texto aprovado da reforma tributária, o transporte público está entre as atividades beneficiadas.

✅ Cesta básica : a proposta de Guedes previa isenção para receitas obtidas com a venda de produtos da cesta básica. A proposta original da PEC 45 não previa desoneração da cesta básica e defendia uma alíquota uniforme, compensando os mais pobres por meio da devolução de tributos. O benefício para a cesta básica foi incorporado posteriormente, durante a tramitação da reforma no Congresso.

✅ Entidades beneficentes, templos religiosos, partidos políticos e entidades sindicais : a proposta de Guedes previa que a CBS não incidisse sobre entidades beneficentes de assistência social, templos religiosos, partidos políticos, sindicatos, federações e confederações. A reforma aprovada preservou as imunidades constitucionais e os tratamentos tributários previstos para essas entidades.

✅ Venda de imóveis residenciais para pessoa física : a proposta de Guedes previa isenção da CBS na venda de imóveis residenciais para pessoas físicas. Já a reforma aprovada conferiu ao setor imobiliário um regime específico, com redutores de ajuste e regras próprias de tributação.

A proposta de Paulo Guedes citava mudanças em outras bases de tributação, como renda , folha de salários e, também, o imposto seletivo.

Defendia redução da tributação sobre empresas e tributação de dividendos para menos pejotização e mais investimento. O texto chegou a ser aprovado pela Câmara dos Deputados , mas não foi adiante.

Além disso, a apresentação divulgada em 2020 pela equipe econômica do governo Bolsonaro também citava a desoneração da folha de salários para redução do custo do trabalho formal. Não falava como isso seria feito, mas Guedes chegou a defender a criação de um imposto sobre transações financeiras .

O governo petista, por sua vez, cumpriu a promessa do presidente Lula de ampliar a faixa de isenção do IR para até R$ 5 mil .

A estimativa da alíquota da CBS em 11,3% para 2027 gerou críticas do setor produtivo; valor est abaixo dos 12% projetados pela gestão anterior. — Foto: Cacá Trovó/EPTV

articles.title: Seize, sell Tata Power's shares in arms: Court
articles.summary: Kleros says Singapore court has ordered authorities to take action in $650Mn award MUMBAI: Tata Power's legal battle with Kleros Capital Partners, a
articles.body: Kleros says Singapore court has ordered authorities to take action in $650Mn awardMUMBAI: Tata Power's legal battle with Kleros Capital Partners, a British Virgin Islands-incorporated resource and infrastructure investment firm, has taken a significant turn after a Singapore court authorised the seizure and sale of shares held by the Tata Group utility in two of its Singapore-based subsidiaries to recover dues arising from a long-running arbitration dispute.In an announcement on Thursday, Kleros said the Singapore International Commercial Court (SICC) has granted enforcement orders empowering the Sheriff of the Singapore courts to seize and sell Tata Power's shareholdings in Bhira Investments and Tata Power International.The move follows the SICC's decision in Aug to dismiss all challenges filed by Tata Power against arbitration awards issued in favour of Kleros.The enforcement action stems from a dispute over the Krutogorovo coal deposit in Russia's Kamchatka region. Kleros and Tata Power had entered into agreements in 2013 and 2014 to explore a joint development of the deposit. However, Kleros later alleged that Tata Power used confidential information obtained under those agreements to pursue the Krutogorovo coal deposit independently.The investment firm initiated arbitration proceedings in Singapore in Nov 2020. In Sept 2023, a three-member tribunal, constituted under the Singapore International Arbitration Centre (SIAC), unanimously ruled that Tata Power had breached contractual obligations by misusing confidential information, circumventing Kleros and concealing material facts while pursuing the coal project on its own.In July 2025, the tribunal awarded Kleros damages of $490 million. Including interest and costs, the total amount now claimed by Kleros exceeds $650 million. According to Kleros, interest continues to accrue at about $71,600 per day.While Tata Power has appealed the SICC's Aug ruling before the Singapore Court of Appeal and the matter remains pending, Kleros said the appeal does not automatically suspend enforcement proceedings and that the company "has not sought a stay of enforcement". As a result, the arbitration awards remain "final, binding and immediately enforceable" under Singapore law.Earlier, the SICC dismissed Tata Power's challenges to the July 2025 SIAC arbitral awards, including its objections to the appointment of two arbitrators who participated in the majority decision forming the basis of the final award. SICC held that there had been no breach of natural justice or the fair hearing rule in the tribunal's conduct.At Tata Power's annual general meeting in July this year, chairman N Chandrasekaran, responding to a shareholder query on the Kleros matter, said the arbitration case remained under appeal and declined to comment further.The two Singapore entities targeted by the enforcement order are as follows: Bhira Investments holds Tata Power's Indonesian coal mining interests, including a 30% stake in PT Kaltim Prima Coal, while Tata Power International serves as the utility's overseas investment holding vehicle.The latest enforcement order, however, raises the stakes in what has become one of the largest arbitration-related claims faced by an Indian corporate entity.You use AI every day. articles.title: US stocks: Wall street bounces back in green after hitting 18-month low as chipmakers rally
articles.summary: Wall Street rebounded from its 18-month low on Friday, led by a sharp recovery in semiconductor stocks, as investors assessed the potential impact of
articles.body: Wall Street rebounded from its 18-month low on Friday, led by a sharp recovery in semiconductor stocks, as investors assessed the potential impact of Democratic election victories on the US artificial intelligence (AI) industry.The recovery followed a steep selloff in the previous session, triggered by fears that the election results could lead to tighter regulations for the AI sector, wiping out trillions of dollars in global stock market value. The gains were led by technology, communication services and industrial stocks.The S&P 500 rose a marginal 0.31% and the Nasdaq Composite advanced 1.1%, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average slipped 0.46%.However, despite Friday's recovery, all three indices ended the week lower following the previous session's sharp losses.Chipmakers lead Wall Street's recoverySemiconductor stocks emerged as the biggest beneficiaries of Friday's rebound. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index gained 4.2%, recovering after suffering its biggest single-day decline since April 2025.Nvidia shares climbed nearly 3%, reversing some of the losses from its previous session, when the stock recorded its worst performance since January 2025. At the time, the emergence of Chinese AI model DeepSeek, which offered a low-cost alternative, had triggered a sharp market reaction.The recovery extended across other major chipmakers. AMD, Intel and Micron Technology ended the session between 5% and 11% higher. Elon Musk's Tesla and SpaceX also bounced back, gaining 4% and nearly 9%, respectively, after declining earlier in the week.Despite Friday's gains, uncertainty over the future regulatory environment continued to weigh on investor sentiment."Most of the disruption of the AI buildout will not probably occur but it's just the uncertainty of the change in government from Republican-led to Democratic-led, not only at the federal level but the state, local levels," said Gerry Sparrow, president and portfolio manager at Sparrow Capital Management."That's causing some disruption in the expectations of investors ... The volatility around elections or any political event, whether it be war or terrorist attack, is always going to disrupt the market."Texas data centre plans add to AI regulation concernsThe prospect of tighter oversight of the AI industry is also emerging at the state level. Texas Democratic Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa said on Thursday that the state would introduce new laws to protect local communities from further large-scale data centre development.Texas already has a substantial share of data centres in the US, making the proposed measures an additional concern for investors tracking the expansion of AI infrastructure.The latest uncertainty comes as the AI trade is already facing questions over the enormous costs involved in building data centres and other infrastructure. Investors are concerned that the scale of these investments could limit future returns.These worries have added to market volatility, triggering margin calls and unsettling retail investors as well as hedge funds.Asian and European markets extend lossesFriday's recovery on Wall Street was in sharp contrast with the performance of other major global markets, where the selloff continued.European equities weakened, with the STOXX 600 declining 1%. In Asia, Japan's Nikkei and South Korea's KOSPI both plunged around 6%.The Nikkei recorded its biggest one-day decline since US President Donald Trump's "Liberation Day" trade tariff turmoil in April 2025. The fall was comparable to Wall Street's previous session, when US stocks suffered their biggest single-day decline since the same period.The broader global market indicators also remained under pressure. The MSCI All-World index fell 0.68%, while MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan dropped nearly 3%.You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. Take the AIQ test.

articles.title: India's forex reserves dip by $2.69 billion: What's behind the decline?
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: India's foreign exchange reserves took a hit in the week ended October 30, falling by $2.691 billion to $717.056 billion, according to the
articles.body: NEW DELHI: India's foreign exchange reserves took a hit in the week ended October 30, falling by $2.691 billion to $717.056 billion, according to the latest data released by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) on Friday.The decline was largely driven by a drop in two key components of the country's reserves, foreign currency assets and gold holdings, which together make up the bulk of the forex kitty.While foreign currency assets and gold reserves fell, India's reserve position with the International Monetary Fund (IMF) recorded a marginal increase.Special Drawing Rights (SDRs), meanwhile, also saw a decline during the week.Foreign currency assets, the biggest part of India's foreign exchange reserves, declined by $2.088 billion to $591.118 billion during the reporting week.Gold reserves also fell by $559 million, taking their value to $102.591 billion.The decline was not limited to these two components. India's SDR holdings, which are reserve assets allocated by the IMF, dropped by $47 million to $18.558 billion.However, the country's reserve position with the IMF increased by $3 million to $4.790 billion.The fall in reserves was also visible in their rupee value. India's total foreign exchange reserves stood at Rs 68.09 lakh crore as of October 30, marking a decline of Rs 24,777 crore from the previous week.Despite the latest weekly decline, India's foreign exchange reserves remain higher than their levels at the end of March 2026.Since the end of March, the country's reserves have increased by $25.949 billion. In rupee terms, the increase during this period stood at Rs 2.55 lakh crore.A year-on-year comparison shows that India's foreign exchange reserves have increased by $27.324 billion, or Rs 6.86 lakh crore.Foreign currency assets registered the biggest increase among the reserve components, rising by $26.527 billion over the year. Gold reserves also increased by $865 million.On the other hand, SDR holdings declined by $87 million during the same period. India's reserve position with the IMF recorded an increase of $18 million.While the latest data shows a weekly decline in the country's foreign exchange reserves, the overall reserve position remains higher than both its end-March 2026 level and its level a year ago.You use AI every day. articles.title: Why new LNG projects may not prevent a global gas crunch this winter
articles.summary: Global natural gas supplies could tighten further during the 2026–27 winter heating season as disruptions to shipments through the Strait of Hormuz
articles.body: Global natural gas supplies could tighten further during the 2026–27 winter heating season as disruptions to shipments through the Strait of Hormuz continue to affect the global liquefied natural gas (LNG) market, the International Energy Agency (IEA) has warned.In its report, the IEA described the disruption as an unprecedented supply shock, noting that LNG loadings from Qatar and the United Arab Emirates declined by 60 billion cubic metres (bcm) year-on-year between March and October 2026.This contributed to a 5 per cent, or 20 bcm, fall in global LNG output, as additional supplies from new projects only partly offset reduced deliveries from the Persian Gulf, according to news agency ANI.With transit through the Strait of Hormuz remaining severely restricted in late October, the agency warned that the disruption could continue to weigh on global gas supplies during the winter months."The disruption of LNG flows through the Strait of Hormuz creates unprecedented uncertainty for the global LNG market ahead of the 2026/27 winter," the report said.It added that "the supply shock looks set to keep imposing tighter market conditions during the northern hemisphere winter, even as supply from new liquefaction plants around the globe continues to grow."Depending on how quickly LNG shipments through the Strait of Hormuz recover, global LNG supply could decline by 10–25 bcm year-on-year between November and March, the IEA said.New LNG projects unlikely to offset Persian Gulf lossesThe scope for increasing pipeline gas supplies remains limited, as long-distance pipelines generally operate close to their designed capacity. This restricts their ability to compensate for shortages in LNG deliveries.North American exporters are expected to drive LNG supply growth during the winter, supported by expanding projects in the United States, Canada and Mexico. Additional volumes are also expected from new facilities in West Africa and Australia.The IEA projects that new LNG projects will add around 18 bcm of supply during the winter, while existing facilities could contribute another 3 bcm. This would take total incremental supply from outside the Persian Gulf to slightly over 20 bcm.However, the additional volumes are not expected to make up for the shortfall from Qatar and the UAE."In total, new and legacy projects outside the Persian Gulf could contribute slightly over 20 bcm of incremental supply y-o-y in the winter period. Despite the strong growth, this extra supply would remain insufficient to compensate for the lost volumes from Qatar and the United Arab Emirates," the report said.IEA outlines two scenarios for winter gas suppliesThe agency outlined two possible scenarios depending on when the Strait of Hormuz resumes normal operations.If the waterway begins progressively reopening in January 2027, global LNG supply could decline by around 9 bcm, or 3 per cent, year-on-year during the winter period.However, if the Strait remains closed until the end of March 2027, the decline could be sharper, with global LNG supply falling by around 20 bcm, or 7 per cent, year-on-year.The IEA also cautioned that unplanned outages and delays in ramping up production at new LNG projects could create additional downside risks to global supplies, particularly while the disruption in the Middle East continues.You use AI every day. articles.title: Stuck at work on Diwali? Firms offer employees longer breaks, better gifts and extra earnings
articles.summary: Stuck at a desk while the rest of the world is busy celebrating may not be the ideal Diwali plan.
articles.body: Stuck at a desk while the rest of the world is busy celebrating may not be the ideal Diwali plan. However, companies are rolling out a range of festive perks to make sure their employees don't miss out on the celebrations.From longer weekends and work-from-home options to gifts of their choice and office festivities, employers are finding different ways to make the festival special for their workforce.And for those who have to work while others celebrate, there are extra payouts and special treats to sweeten the deal.Gifts employees actually wantFor employees at quick-commerce firm Zepto, the festive break has come a day earlier than scheduled. The company advanced its holiday from Tuesday to Monday, giving its workforce an additional day off after Diwali."We want our people to enjoy the festive season with their families by giving them a longer weekend to celebrate," Sneha Arora, chief HR officer at the Bengaluru-headquartered firm told ET.At Hitachi India, employees had the opportunity to decide what they wanted as their festive gifts. The diversified manufacturer asked them to vote from a list of options, with air fryers and Amazon gift vouchers emerging as popular choices.Festive celebrations at the company also extended beyond gifts. Hitachi India hosted gatherings at hotels across the country, bringing together its Indian and Japanese employees, including senior leadership, said chief human resources officer Ashutosh Anshu.WFH for those traveling homeFor employees planning to travel during Diwali, flexibility over where they work has also become part of the festive arrangements.Hitachi India's hybrid work policy allows employees to work from home for two days a week. This gives them room to manage festive travel and personal commitments, Anshu said.Aditya Mishra, chief executive at staffing and recruitment services firm CIEL HR Services, said greater flexibility in how employees celebrate has been a noticeable trend this festive season.Companies are extending work-from-home options wherever the nature of the job allows it, particularly for employees who want to travel to their hometowns but continue working."more work-from-home options are given wherever the nature of the role permits, to help employees who wish to travel to their hometowns and continue working", he said.When the festive spirit has to reach the workplaceNot everyone gets to switch off during Diwali. Employees working in housekeeping, security, office support, electrical and maintenance roles may still need to keep offices functioning during the celebrations.Proptech firm NoBroker.com is organising special festivities for these teams, along with a role-reversal exercise involving its HR department.Under the initiative, HR employees will take on the responsibilities usually handled by support staff for a few hours. This includes staffing office floors, managing security and ensuring that operations continue, allowing the employees in these roles to participate in the celebrations."For those few hours, our HR team steps into their shoes, staffing the floors, managing security and keeping the offices running, so that not a single person has to miss the festivities," said chief executive Amit Kumar Agarwal.Diwali duty comes with extra earningsFor employees whose work involves being on the road, festive celebrations are also taking the form of additional financial incentives.Trev Mobility, an electric vehicles-focused cab-hailing service, has introduced a special incentive programme for its driver-partners working during Diwali, according to ET. The additional payouts will be over and above their regular earnings for working on designated festive days, said founder Naveen Gupta.The amount drivers can earn will depend on how many days they choose to work. Those available for just one or two days can also qualify for additional earnings, while driver-partners who complete all four designated days of duty, including Diwali, will be eligible for a significantly enhanced payout.Under the programme, those completing all four days will receive double payment, Gupta said."The incentive is structured around the number of days they choose to work, so even those available for one or two days can earn extra. Those who complete all four designated days of duty, including Diwali, are eligible for a significantly enhanced payout, with double payment under the programme," he added.You use AI every day. articles.title: Sergio, gorrilla en Sevilla, revela cuánto puede ganar al día: “Me vi en el calle y esto es dinero al momento”
articles.standfirst: Cuenta en las cámaras de ‘Equipo de investigación’, de La Sexta, lo que consigue en un mes
articles.summary: Cuenta en las cámaras de ‘Equipo de investigación’, de La Sexta, lo que consigue en un mes
articles.body: En algún momento, todos los ciudadanos españoles hemos tenido que pagar a un gorrilla que nos ha ‘ayudado’ a aparcar el coche. La tarifa no es fija, cada uno abona lo que considera oportuno. El problema es si crees que no es lo más correcto y te vas sin dejarle propina. Es en esta situación cuando pueden surgir los problemas y las consecuencias. En ‘Equipo de Investigación’, de La Sexta, han charlado con Sergio, un gorrilla que opera en Sevilla. Con total sinceridad, cuenta ante la cámara que puede llegar a rondar los 1.000 euros mensuales solo con la propina por ayudar a aparcar. De hecho, lo describe como una forma de “ganar dinero al momento”. De hecho, lleva dos meses trabajando de “aparcacoches”, como él mismo se define. “Me vi en la calle y esto es dinero al momento. Como no paro, saco de 30 a 40 euros al día. Si me lo curro todo el mes, puedo llevarme 900 euros. Pero donde hay alguien, ni te pones, porque eso se respeta”, apunta el primerizo en este tipo de tarea. Hay que tener en cuenta que, pese a las multas y la vigilancia policial, los aparcacoches siguen presentes en la calle. Más llamativo es el caso de Willy Jemba. Aunque, actualmente, se mueve por las calles como gorrilla, él asegura que es algo temporal, ya que su verdadera profesión es el fútbol. De hecho, cuenta que jugó en el París Saint-Germain y en el Espanyol. En Murcia, se puede intervenir el dinero obtenido por la actividad de los gorrillas gracias a una ordenanza municipal. Según su relato, Jemba fue futbolista profesional, pero ahora tiene “problemas de residencia”. Lo suyo parece temporal, pues su verdadera intención es volver a los terrenos de juego: “Estoy entrenando para coger forma”.

articles.body: NEW DELHI: Diwali season is a holiday for most, but Dalal Street refuses to let the festive mood go to waste!For one special hour, the trading terminals light up and investors get a shot at starting the new year with a good ‘Muhurat.’That is the charm of Muhurat Trading, the annual Diwali session when the stock exchanges open their doors for a brief spell. More than just another trading session, it marks the beginning of Samvat, the traditional Hindu financial year, and is seen as an auspicious time to begin new investments.The roots of the tradition lie in Diwali's association with wealth and prosperity. During the Lakshmi Puja, devotees worship Goddess Lakshmi, while businesses perform Chopda Puja, offering prayers before their account books, cash boxes and financial records, seeking prosperity in the year ahead.Over time, this age-old practice found a place on Dalal Street. Investors began buying and selling shares during the special Diwali session as a symbolic way of welcoming the new Samvat.The ritual may have moved from account books to trading screens, but its central idea remains the same: start the financial year on an auspicious note.When is Muhurat Trading 2026? articles.title: Elon Musk's futuristic dream vehicle to cease production - What went wrong with Tesla's Cybertruck
articles.summary: Tesla's Cybertruck arrived with big ambitions, a futuristic design and Elon Musk's backing. Now, it is bidding adieu.
articles.body: Tesla's Cybertruck arrived with big ambitions, a futuristic design and Elon Musk's backing.Now, it is bidding adieu.The high-tech pickup was meant to shake up the automobile industry, but its journey is coming to an end. Musk announced on Friday that Tesla would wind down Cybertruck production around the middle of 2027 at its facility outside Austin, Texas.The move will make room for increased production of the company's Cybercab robotaxi, as Tesla shifts its focus towards autonomous vehicles.But what led to the Cybertruck's early exit? A combination of disappointing sales, a price tag that was much higher than initially promised and growing controversy surrounding Musk.1. Sales and pricing failed to meet expectationsMusk had projected annual production of 250,000 Cybertrucks, but sales remained far below that target. Kelley Blue Book estimated that Tesla sold just 20,237 units last year, around half the previous year's sales. Sales through September this year fell another 28%. Spencer Penn, a former Tesla executive who left before the Cybertruck's launch and now heads software developer LightSource, said electric trucks had struggled to attract demand.“A really controversial vehicle unveiled by a controversial individual into a market where none of the electric trucks have been able to really capture demand,” he said.Pricing was another hurdle. Musk had promised a price tag below $40,000, but the first Cybertrucks sold for double that amount or more. Penn, who had booked a pre-sale reservation, eventually decided against buying one after the promised price failed to materialise.2. Its design made it impossible to ignoreWith its sharp angles and stainless-steel body, the Cybertruck looked more like a science-fiction vehicle than a conventional pickup. Its 2019 unveiling grabbed attention when a Tesla designer threw a metal ball at its supposedly unbreakable glass, only for the window to shatter. A second attempt on another window ended the same way. Musk, however, remained convinced about his vision.“I just wanted to make a futuristic battle tank — something that looks like it could come out of ‘Blade Runner’ or ‘Aliens’ or something like that but was also highly functional,” he told Automotive News.He called it “a better sports car than a Porsche 911” and “a better truck than an F-150.” The design drew both admiration and ridicule. Armen Hareyan, whose Torque News site covers autos, said: “Few vehicles in history have generated as much attention. The Cybertruck became a cultural symbol – loved, mocked and impossible to ignore.”Penn initially found its appearance revolting and called it “madness”, but his opinion changed the more he looked at it. He eventually saw it as an example of Tesla's adventurous spirit and willingness to take risks. “Some of these bets work and some of these bets don’t,” he said.3. Musk's political image became a problem for some customersMusk's association with several right-wing figures, particularly US President Donald Trump, alienated some Tesla customers. As his image shifted from an eccentric innovator to a polarising figure trading his billions for political influence, some previously passionate owners rushed to sell their cars. Others put stickers on their bumpers reading, “I bought this before Elon went crazy.”The backlash extended to demonstrations outside Tesla showrooms, with organisers also urging investors to sell their shares. Some protests turned violent, with Molotov cocktails thrown at Tesla vehicles, charging stations set ablaze and dealerships covered in graffiti. Cybertruck owners faced hostility too, with some being shouted at with “Nazi!” and receiving extended middle fingers.Ross Blankenship, a Cybertruck owner, said that he disliked seeing a vehicle he loved turned into a political symbol. Its futuristic appearance had reminded him of “Halo”, the science-fiction video game he played as a child.“I had that sort of child in me wanting to be part of something cool that would change the future of automotive,” Blankenship said in a call from his Cybertruck as he drove through Sunnyside, Colorado.Although he said he agreed with Musk on politics, he was unhappy about the vehicle becoming associated with the controversy.“I never bought it for any other reason than the fascination with the future technology of trucks … so that was a little heartbreaking.” The Cybertruck's discontinuation also comes as Tesla shifts its attention towards autonomous vehicles. Musk said winding down production would allow the company to make more Cybercab robotaxis, a segment on which he is betting Tesla's future.For a vehicle that Musk once called Tesla's best product, the planned shutdown marks an unceremonious end to a much-hyped project. Yet, it has not lost all its fans. Blankenship said he would buy another Cybertruck again in a heartbeat. He called the end of its production “a sad moment.”You use AI every day. articles.title: Coca-Cola's Indian bottling business files for IPO; 99.75 crore shares up for sale
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: The Coca-Cola Company's Indian bottling business, Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings Ltd (HCCH), has initiated the process for a stock market listing
articles.body: NEW DELHI: The Coca-Cola Company's Indian bottling business, Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings Ltd (HCCH), has initiated the process for a stock market listing by filing its draft IPO papers with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi).The proposed initial public offering (IPO) will involve the sale of up to 99.75 crore equity shares by promoter Hindustan Coca-Cola Overseas Holdings Pte Ltd, according to the draft red herring prospectus (DRHP) dated November 6. The issue will be entirely an offer for sale (OFS), which means HCCH will not receive any money from the IPO. All proceeds will go to the selling shareholder.The filing follows Coca-Cola's statement in June that it was exploring a potential listing of HCCH in 2027. HCCH is the parent entity of Hindustan Coca-Cola Beverages (HCCB), the company's Indian bottling arm.HCCH's beverage portfolio and distribution networkHCCH operates across three beverage categories: sparkling, hydration and stills, including juices. Its activities include preparing, packaging, distributing and selling beverages, with its portfolio comprising 41 products as of June 30, 2026.The company had a distribution network spanning around 1.7 million retail outlets, supported by 2,273 distributors, as of June 30, 2026.The TKC Report cited in the DRHP identifies HCCH as the largest non-alcoholic ready-to-drink (NARTD) beverage company by revenue among businesses operating exclusively in India in FY26. It also ranks the company as the largest bottler within the Coca-Cola System in India, based on units of concentrate sold.HCCH's retained units reported revenue from operations of Rs 4,310.17 crore for the three months ended June 30, 2026, registering a year-on-year increase of 20.46 per cent. Total sales volume grew 18.61 per cent over the same period.Who owns HCCH?The Coca-Cola Company held a 60 per cent stake in HCCH through Hindustan Coca-Cola Overseas Holdings Pte Ltd as of the DRHP filing date. The remaining 40 per cent was owned by Jubilant Beverages Ltd, which became one of HCCH's promoters in July 2025.The proposed listing also comes amid Coca-Cola's global asset-light strategy, under which the beverage major has been divesting its bottling assets. India is its fifth-largest market globally.In 2024, the company transferred its bottling operations in Rajasthan, Bihar, the Northeast and parts of West Bengal to existing bottlers through franchise arrangements. These transactions generated $290 million (around Rs 2,420 crore) for Coca-Cola.Kandhari Global Beverages, SLMG Beverages and Moon Beverages were awarded the franchises.HCCB's manufacturing footprint in IndiaCoca-Cola operates in India through two entities: Coca-Cola India and Hindustan Coca-Cola Beverages (HCCB). Incorporated in February 1997, HCCB operates 14 bottling plants across the country.The company is headquartered in Bengaluru, with operations spread across 10 states. Its manufacturing and sales portfolio includes Coca-Cola, Thums Up, Sprite, Minute Maid, Maaza, SmartWater, Kinley, Limca and Fanta, among others.Kotak Mahindra Capital Company, Citigroup Global Markets India, JP Morgan India, Morgan Stanley India Company, Axis Capital, Goldman Sachs (India) Securities and IIFL Capital Services are the book-running lead managers to the issue, while KFin Technologies is the registrar.You use AI every day. articles.body: The US midterm elections could accelerate the ongoing rotation in stock markets, with healthcare emerging as a potential defensive investment amid a correction in artificial intelligence (AI)-related stocks, according to Lou Miller, global head of custom basket trading at Goldman Sachs.Speaking on Goldman Sachs' The Markets podcast, Miller said investors had already started moving towards defensive positions ahead of the elections, amid a challenging environment for active investors in the second half of 2026."We've seen people get very defensive. If you look at beta-adjusted net exposure in our prime book, it's definitely at very low levels versus history," he said.Miller pointed to sharp declines in several segments of the AI investment theme. Data centre stocks have fallen 36% from their highs earlier this year, while memory stocks have declined 42%, optical networking stocks 46% and NeoCloud stocks 57%.However, he said the correction had lowered expectations and could leave room for positive surprises."I think the silver lining is the bar is much, much lower for surprises and there are positive catalysts ahead," he said."The multiple for the data centre trade is about half of what it was in June," Miller added, saying valuations had moved to healthier levels.Healthcare emerges as potential AI growth areaMiller identified healthcare as a possible beneficiary of the next phase of AI adoption, saying the sector could be among the few to see accelerating earnings growth next year."I think the next leg of the AI trade is actually healthcare, and I think that's also a very defensive sector that historically is very uncorrelated to AI," he said.He noted that healthcare companies were increasingly adopting AI in areas such as medical tools and diagnostics, with the sector moving from challenges towards growth opportunities.Miller, however, cautioned against treating traditional defensive sectors such as consumer staples as automatically attractive, arguing that elevated valuations had reduced their appeal."Expensive defensives I don't think are defensive," he said.He suggested investors focus on companies with strong balance sheets, quality earnings and healthy free cash flows.Goldman Sachs executive outlines market outlookOutlining his preferred investment strategy, Miller said: "I think the S&P 500 excluding AI is the trade."He cited attractive valuations and earnings growth prospects as reasons for his preference.Looking ahead, Miller identified employment, inflation, corporate earnings and the US Federal Reserve's December 9 policy decision as key factors that could influence markets.On the outlook for US stocks towards the end of the year, he expressed cautious optimism, anticipating a modest rally that he described as a "relaxed Santa Rally".You use AI every day. articles.title: AI-powered hacking risk is getting worse — and that's before 'Q-day'
articles.summary: A new note from Bank of America says that while quantum can deliver significant efficiency gains, classical computing isn't going away — and neither is the s...
articles.body:
The Binance hack was a harsh reminder: Nothing online is truly safe.

After the largest cryptocurrency theft on record — initiated through classic phishing but executed through AI tools — corporate America and security analysts are warning of the fresh dangers posed by sophisticated AI technology, which can find and exploit software flaws much faster than people can.

The risks, it seems, are on the rise for everyone.

"This is every crypto platform, every wallet service, every bank, every financial institution that you use," Binance co-founder Changpeng Zhao said in an interview with Yahoo Finance. "Especially now with AI improving so quickly, I think we're going to see a lot more of this."

While the hack underscored the weaknesses of centralized financial intermediaries, rather than the underlying blockchain technology, "its effects could spread to other market participants," Moody's analysts wrote in a note this week.

Circle's ( CRCL ) Jeremy Allaire told us this week that the acceleration of agentic AI means risk is accelerating dramatically in tandem.

"Any critical infrastructure, any major industry, hospital systems, energy systems, utilities, financial industry participants — everyone has risk here," he said. "I think the threat vectors are some of the most intense vectors we have ever seen in the history of the world. I think we are in a hot environment right now, and everyone needs to be operating from the assumption that they are under attack."

It's truly wild to think that bank robberies, a phenomenon that seems almost archaic, are a risk that has somehow boomeranged back.

And just like AI's turbocharged hacking worries, a new tech specter sits on the horizon, without a kill switch : "Q-day."

Quantum computing presents an enticing idea: the ability to tackle calculations that would be impractical for legacy computers, while using far less energy.

As early as 2030, computer scientists project that quantum computers can break the traditional encryption that safeguards pillars of the economy, such as the financial system and global communications, a moment the industry calls "Q-day."

It's something we've been seeing in Wall Street analyst research that's mostly been absent from broader headlines, because it's more long-term. But in September, Bank of America's thematic research team noted that a key security algorithm could be broken with far fewer quantum bits (qubits) than previously thought. In just 10 months, researchers saw progress to the tune of a 99% (not a typo) decrease.

articles.title: Expert gives advice to independent contractors on how to save for retirement
articles.summary: Even modest contributions made during a temporary job can benefit from tax-deferred growth.
articles.body: If you’re an independent contractor working for a few clients throughout the year, you have to be very intentional about building your retirement savings however you can. Certified financial planner Douglas Boneparth advises one independent worker about a temporary but annually recurring savings opportunity. A reader wrote: I work as a contractual employee for the state of Maryland during their 90-day legislative session and have never taken advantage of their offer to open a 401(k). Should I take advantage of this or is it more complicated than the payoff? They usually erase all my info at the end of session wherein I need to re-establish myself anew every year. Would the 401(k) stay in place, and would I be able to continue to contribute even though the job ended? DOUG: Great question, and I want to make sure you don’t leave money on the table here, because I think you might be. Let’s start with the most important thing: Yes, the 401(k) stays. It’s yours. When your session ends and your employment technically stops, the account doesn’t disappear with your HR file. The money you contributed (and any growth on it) belongs to you. You just can’t make new contributions until you’re re-enrolled and employed again during the following session. Now, is it worth the hassle of re-establishing your contributions every year? In most cases, yes, and here’s why. Even modest contributions made over a short legislative session benefit from tax-deferred growth. And if there’s any employer match involved, that’s an instant return on your money that’s very hard to replicate anywhere else. The administrative friction exists, but it’s a solvable problem, not a reason to opt out. Here’s what I’d suggest. When you re-enroll each session, treat it like a recurring appointment you can’t miss. Put it on the calendar the moment you know your start date. Contribute as much as you reasonably can during the session. When the session ends, you have options. Primarily that’s to leave the money in the plan, or roll it over to an IRA, which consolidates everything in one place under your full control and gives you more investment flexibility. The short answer here is the payoff is almost certainly worth it. Please don’t let the paperwork be the reason you leave tax-advantaged dollars behind. Tip of the week: Take advantage of free money Starting in 2027, many workers may qualify for a federal Saver’s Match. Who’s eligible? Anyone with a modified adjusted gross income below $35,500 ($71,000 if married) who is also eligible to contribute to a qualified retirement plan (eg, a 401(k), 403(b), 457(b), deductible IRA or state-based auto IRA). The Saver’s Match is worth up to $1,000 ($2,000 if married). It’s money you claim on your 2027 federal income tax return, which you can file in early 2028. And starting this year, if a Trump Account is opened for your child, you may get $1,000 from the federal government if your child was born between January 1, 2025, and December 31, 2028. That amount may be doubled if you work for an employer who has pledged to match the federal seed money. And for any of your children under age 18, the account may be eligible for a contribution from philanthropies or state governments that have pledged money for Trump Accounts.

articles.title: ‘I think I was in shock’: 28-year-old’s emotional moment when she sees how much she may have at retirement
articles.summary: Abbey Graf was shocked when projections by a certified financial planner showed she could have potentially as much as $4 million if she retires at age 65.
articles.body: Food stamp policy analyst Abbey Graf had kind of an emotional moment when she saw the wealth management roadmap that certified financial planner Stacy Francis created based on her current income, expenses and savings. “I think I was in shock. I knew I was in a good place. But I don’t think I was fully aware of how much I would have at retirement if I keep pace (with my savings),” Abbey said. Spoiler alert: She could have potentially as much as $4 million if she retires at age 65 – or more than $2.5 million if she chooses early retirement at 57. To recap: At just 28, Abbey has amassed a lot in savings both for her age and her $74,360 income. She currently has no debt beyond the $1,246 remaining on her federal student loan. (While she could easily pay that off, she worried doing so would hurt her credit score since credit bureaus give credit for managing debt.) But her anxiety about money – and the future – has kept her from really seeing clearly just how solid her financial foundation is. And it has precluded her from doing things today that she really enjoys, like traveling and taking on more hobbies. Despite her positive cash flow and financial discipline, “emotionally, Abbey still worried she was ‘behind,’” Stacy said in an email. “We are seeing this disconnect constantly, especially among younger women. Many are doing quite well financially on paper, but because of social media comparisons, really scary economic headlines, and rising costs of everyday items, they still feel financially insecure.” Stacy did projections for two scenarios: the base plan, in which Abbey keeps her current below-market monthly rent of $1,350, adjusted for inflation over time; and a second plan in which she buys a $400,000 home next year and sells it in 2038. Stacy concluded Abbey would end up with a larger nest egg by continuing to rent. If she retired at 65 she could have a portfolio worth $3.976 million – or about $740,000 more than in the home-buying scenario. Those projections assume average annual inflation of 3.1% (including a 4.5% inflation rate for medical care). And given Abbey’s financial anxieties, Stacy made the conservative assumption that her portfolio would return just 5% a year – far less than the 10.12% average annual return of a moderate-risk blend portfolio with 60% large-cap US stocks and 40% US bonds, according to Morningstar data. Notably, too, Stacy’s projections do not assume Abbey, who currently is a contractor, will ever work for an employer that offers a match on her retirement savings. Should she work for one, however, that would only further improve her nest egg. The projections “completely changed her perception of what was possible,” Stacy said. “Even under conservative assumptions, our analysis showed that Abbey can retire many years earlier than she originally expected.” As a result, Abbey now feels a lot more comfortable taking a vacation and taking up new hobbies that she would enjoy but previously avoided because they cost money. “I think I will slowly ramp up to not shock the system,” she said. “Maybe I should take a pottery class.” In the future, Stacy recommended Abbey take four action steps: What’s next: We’ll catch up with Abbey again in a few weeks. But next week, we have our last check in with Mariza and Geffrey Gordon, who are starting to think differently about how they manage money.
